title: Find a Grave memorial 190642286 — Ronald E. Totosz
citation: Find a Grave, memorial 190642286, "Ronald E. Totosz" (1941–2004), Chapel Hill Gardens, Merle Hay mausoleum, Des Moines, Polk County, Iowa. Memorial created 16 June 2018 by contributor "Katie Lou"; niche photograph added 11 April 2022. Shared niche with Okhe Totosz, 1940–2020.
notes: Confirms burial in Des Moines and the shared niche with his wife, and was the first record to connect the phonetic "Tototz" Larry remembered to the spelling Totosz. A user-contributed database rather than an official record: it is good evidence of dates and place of burial, and is not independent of the obituary for anything else. He enlisted from 1211 Merle Hay Road in 1962 and was interred on the same road 42 years later.
